state.question: Two bodies initially at 400 K and 100 K each have constant heat capacity 10 J/K. An ideal reversible heat engine operates between them until no more work can be extracted. They exchange no heat with the outside; the engine completes cycles and stores no net energy. What is the maximum work output?
